mission: Common area. An argument about hyperspace routes stops being about hyperspace routes within thirty seconds. The wound's amplification hits the room — arguments louder than they should be, Sera and Kael saying sentences that are not quite theirs, Ben catching his own disproportionate anger mid-sentence. The wound is in this room now, not cosmic.
why_now: The wound has been a cosmic threat for the whole book. The reader needs to feel it operating on these five specific people in a space they can't leave. Every later pressure beat rides on this one.
conflict: The trigger is trivial — a route choice, a rotation disagreement, a word said the wrong way. The volume is not. The wound amplifies emotional extremes without possessing anyone; the argument is real and their own, just louder than it would otherwise be. Each speaker keeps catching themselves mid-breath.
turning_point: Ben feels his own anger spike disproportionate to its content, catches himself mid-sentence, stops. The wound is not only at Veranthos. It is on the ship.
opening_hook: The argument starts about hyperspace routes. It stops being about hyperspace routes within thirty seconds.
closing_hook: After the fight, silence. Desh brings everyone something to eat without being asked. Nobody thanks him. He doesn't expect them to. The silence after the argument is more informative than the argument itself.
emotional_trajectory: Simmering tension -> explosive argument -> exhausted silence

stakes.personal: Ben recognising the wound's influence on his own emotional state
stakes.interpersonal: Group cohesion fracturing under external psychic pressure
stakes.external: If the wound can amplify their tensions, it is doing the same to every Force-sensitive in range

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — common area, cramped and overheated
sensory_details: The ship too warm; recycled air stale; voices bouncing off metal walls; Ben's own anger arriving hotter than its content should permit; Desh's food-rounds after, practical kindness where resolution does not exist
action_beats: Sera slams her palm on the nav console mid-argument — the sound silencing the cockpit for a breath
Ben catches himself mid-sentence as his own anger spikes disproportionate — the wound pushing
Desh brings food to each person without being asked, navigating the silent aftermath
notes: The wound's amplification is the scene's engine — arguments louder than their subject, fear cutting deeper, disproportionate emotion that catches its owner mid-breath. Not possession; pressurisation. Rotate Force-wrongness metaphor here: atmospheric/weather vocabulary (pressure at altitude, a front moving through, barometric change before a storm) rather than acoustic or navigational. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, theorise the amplification as a phenomenon. He catches himself mid-sentence; he stops; the stop is the recognition. Voice: Zahn-tight dialogue, one permitted Stover-interior beat when Ben catches his own amplified anger. Desh's food round becomes the clearest visible moment of his minor arc turning — practical care as genuine investment; do not have him narrate it.
